announcer_mentions#ann_caption_source_un.rationale: Word-rate and mention-text inputs are defined; the only blocker is that MLB.TV/RSN streams are DRM and ToS restricted and no licensed caption or transcript vendor is reachable from here.

announcer_mentions#ann_crew_visibility.rationale: Crew identity is a defined input; whether it is knowable pregame can only be measured by timestamped capture of network releases and listings over a season, which are not archived with post times.

announcer_mentions#ann_no_series.rationale: No MLB announcer-mention series is listed and no rules were sampled, so feed, speakers and counting rules exist only once Kalshi lists such a market; nothing in the catalog can settle it.

announcer_mentions#ann_transcript_data.rationale: The input is defined, but no public per-crew transcript corpus exists and large-scale capture is limited by broadcast rights; a licensed caption archive is the only clean source and is not accessible here.

extras_and_delay#ext_delay_record.rationale: Delay frequency input is defined from Stats API/box-score delay fields; the open question is the recording completeness of that source for short stoppages, a source-quality limitation rather than a missing mechanism.

extras_and_delay#ext_delay_scope.rationale: Sampled KXMLBDELAY text is silent on postponements, suspended-and-resumed games and very short stoppages; only Kalshi's full rules or settled examples can say how they count.

extras_and_delay#ext_filing.rationale: Each of KXMLBEXTRAS and KXMLBDELAY was sampled once in October; regular-season wording and doubleheader/rescheduled mapping to 'originally scheduled' are unseen in Kalshi text.

extras_and_delay#ext_lineup_vintage.rationale: The record admits no input defines the as-of timestamp of lineup cards, probable-pitcher changes or roof/postponement announcements, so the point-in-time state the extras model conditions on is undefined.
extras_and_delay#ext_lineup_vintage.catalog_action: Add as-of timestamp fields (announcement time, source endpoint, revision) to the lineup, probable-pitcher, roof-status and postponement-call inputs of extras_and_delay, reusing the shared lineup-vintage definition.

extras_and_delay#ext_stadium_weather.rationale: Rain-timing needs park-level nowcast/radar; the input is defined but licensed radar and nowcast feeds are paid/unavailable here and MRMS archive access was not verified.

first5_markets#f5_filing.rationale: All five F-series were sampled for one postseason game each; regular-season postponement windows and F7 treatment of games ended between seven and nine innings are not visible in Kalshi text.

first5_markets#f5_probable_vintage.rationale: Probable-pitcher change risk is a defined input and MLB feeds expose announcements live, but announcement history is not archived, so calibration needs prospective own capture of probable-pitcher timestamps.

first5_markets#f5_short_game.rationale: Sampled F5 rules cover postponement and delay but not a game ended before five innings or a suspended game; settlement there can only come from Kalshi rules or settled examples.

first5_markets#f5_starter_change_settlem.rationale: KXMLBF5 text has no pitcher clause and no rule for a game called mid-fifth or the unplayed home half; starter-change non-voiding is inference from silence that only Kalshi can confirm.

first5_markets#f5_trip_penalty_variation.rationale: Whether the second-look penalty is pitcher-specific (arsenal width) or league-wide, and its post-2023 regime, is an open specification of the TTO input that public Statcast data can settle.
first5_markets#f5_trip_penalty_variation.catalog_action: Research pitcher-specific versus league-wide second-trip penalty on 2021+ Statcast by arsenal cluster and author the TTO input as either a league term or an arsenal-conditioned term with regime flag.

first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_clos.rationale: Bullpen roles are team conventions never published in structured form; the input can be derived from leverage-index usage, but the raw role source itself does not exist publicly.

first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_f7_f.rationale: Only the 9th-inning strike's fair-price clause was sampled; whether other KXMLBINNINGTOTAL/INNINGWIN innings and suspended-resumed games share it is not stated in Kalshi text.

first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_inni.rationale: Only 9th-inning strikes were sampled; whether innings 2-8 or extras are listed and how unplayed or automatic-runner innings settle depends on Kalshi listings and rules not in the sample.

first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_misf.rationale: Inputs mlb.f3_split, mlb.tto and the PA dataset still carry F3/F5 content inherited from a superseded filing, so the archetype's input list is wrong for the three inning series it now holds.
first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_misf.catalog_action: Strip F3/F5-specific content from mlb.f3_split, mlb.tto and the PA dataset in first_inning_and_inning_markets, keeping only inputs serving KXMLBRFI, INNINGTOTAL and INNINGWIN.

first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_rfi_.rationale: KXMLBRFI's sampled rule is one sentence with no postponement, suspension or called-game clause; first-inning settlement in those cases needs the full Kalshi rule document.

first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_spli.rationale: Whether a first-inning-specific pitcher skill exists beyond first-trip PA outcomes is an undecided mechanism of the RFI input set, testable on public play-by-play.
first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_spli.catalog_action: Research variance decomposition of starter first-inning run prevention beyond PA-level skill on multiple seasons and either add or explicitly reject a first-inning skill input.

game_moneyline#ml_gamewinner_rules.rationale: KXMLBGAME/STGAME text covers postponement within two days and cancellation but not suspended-resumed or rain-shortened official games; only Kalshi can define those settlements.

game_moneyline#ml_hfa_mechanism.rationale: Home-field advantage decomposition (last at-bat vs park/travel) and post-2023 regime are unresolved in the HFA input; Retrosheet/Stats API by inning and park make it researchable.
game_moneyline#ml_hfa_mechanism.catalog_action: Research HFA by inning and by park over 10+ seasons with a post-2023 regime check and author the HFA input as separated structural and park/travel components.

game_moneyline#ml_lineup_vintage.rationale: Lineup inputs are defined and posted lineups are public, but post timestamps are not archived, so point-in-time backtests require prospective capture of lineup and probable endpoints.

game_moneyline#ml_misfiled_series.rationale: GAME and SPREAD samples are postseason and STGAME is spring; regular-season wording is unseen in Kalshi text, which only Kalshi listings can expose.

game_moneyline#ml_spring_tie.rationale: KXMLBSTGAME has no tie clause though spring games can end tied; whether ties resolve No, at fair price or are impossible under the game's rules is only answerable by Kalshi.

game_total_and_team_total#tot_extras_sco.rationale: KXMLBTOTAL/TEAMTOTAL sampled text does not say whether extra-inning runs count or how postponed/suspended/shortened games settle; resolvable only by Kalshi rule text or settled examples.

game_total_and_team_total#tot_park_axis_.rationale: wind_vector_park needs each park's home-plate-to-centre bearing and wall geometry, but required_data names no source; these are static public facts the author can compile.
game_total_and_team_total#tot_park_axis_.catalog_action: Author a verified park-orientation table (home plate to centre-field bearing from stadium coordinates/diagrams, wall distances/heights) as a named source of wind_vector_park.

game_total_and_team_total#tot_postseason.rationale: Residual gap is a rule fact: confirming the automatic runner remains regular-season-only in 2026 is a lookup the author has not done; the contract question duplicates tot_extras_scope.
game_total_and_team_total#tot_postseason.catalog_action: Read the 2026 Official Baseball Rules / MLB regulations extras provision and record which regime (runner vs bases empty) extras_run_contribution uses for each game type.

game_total_and_team_total#tot_series_dep.rationale: Within-postseason-series dependence beyond starters is defined as a test, but only a few dozen postseason series per year exist, so the history is coverage-limited for identifying it.

game_total_and_team_total#tot_strike_wor.rationale: KXMLBTOTAL/TEAMTOTAL text has missing words and a title/rule mismatch; the likely reading is clear but only Kalshi can correct the wording; floor_strike metadata is supporting evidence only.

game_total_and_team_total#tot_weather_re.rationale: Park-relative wind component is defined; whether free grid/airport forecasts resolve stadium-level wind well enough is a source-resolution limit, with stadium sensors not accessible.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_bvp_sam.rationale: Whether a shrunk batter-vs-pitch-type term belongs in the hits input set or platoon-only suffices is an open input definition, settleable on public PA logs.
hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_bvp_sam.catalog_action: Research platoon-only versus shrunk pitch-type matchup on held-out logged PAs and author the matchup input with its chosen form and shrinkage, or remove it.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_hrr_cha.rationale: KXMLBHRR's runs and RBI components lack the lineup-neighbour base-out chain input defined in the RBI archetype, so the hits record has a missing interaction.
hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_hrr_cha.catalog_action: Define one shared pa_base_out_state_chain input and attach it to hitter_hits_and_total_bases for KXMLBHRR alongside the RBI archetype.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_lineup_.rationale: Start-gate inputs are defined; card post timestamps are not archived publicly, so point-in-time hitter backtests need prospective capture of the lineup endpoint.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_misfile.rationale: KXMLBHIT, TB and HRR were each sampled for one postseason game; regular-season participation wording is unseen in Kalshi text.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_regime_.rationale: Post-2023 shift ban and base-size changes may break the outcome model's stationarity; the catalog has no regime indicator input, a missing definition researchable on public data.
hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_regime_.catalog_action: Research BABIP/extra-base mix by season 2019-2025 and author a rule-regime indicator input (pre/post-2023) for the hits and total bases outcome model.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_settlem.rationale: Sampled hits/TB rules name no data source and no postponement or scorer-change policy; whether Kalshi re-reads after hit/error changes is a contract clarification only Kalshi can give.

hitter_home_runs#hr_ball_regime.rationale: Ball-carry regime is defined as inferred from league HR/FB residuals because no public per-game measurement of ball properties exists; the raw source is unavailable.

hitter_home_runs#hr_derby_rules.rationale: Only an October 2026 KXMLBHR contract was sampled; regular-season participation-gate wording is unseen in Kalshi text.

hitter_home_runs#hr_extras_postponement.rationale: KXMLBHR text is silent on extra-inning HRs, postponement, suspension and rain-shortened games; settled examples or full Kalshi rules are needed.

hitter_home_runs#hr_opp_starter_change.rationale: The HR ladder evaluates pitcher_hr_vulnerability for the announced starter only and lacks the probable-pitcher-change input, a missing mechanism since a scratch does not trigger fair price.
hitter_home_runs#hr_opp_starter_change.catalog_action: Attach a shared probable-pitcher-change input to hitter_home_runs and define pitcher_hr_vulnerability as a mixture over announced and likely replacement starters.

hitter_home_runs#hr_wind_source.rationale: Wind input is defined; free forecast APIs give grid/airport values rather than ball-height stadium wind, and stadium sensors are paid/inaccessible here.

hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_opportunity_vint.rationale: Lineup cards and starters are public but unversioned; the inputs are defined and point-in-time history requires own snapshot capture.

hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_runs_scope.rationale: The archetype description claims runs scored though no runs-scored series exists, so the record's scope statement is wrong and must be reconciled with the series actually filed (RBI, SB).
hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_runs_scope.catalog_action: Revise hitter_rbis_runs_sb scope to the filed series (KXMLBRBI, KXMLBSB), drop runs-scored inputs unless a runs ladder is found in the series ledger.

hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_sb_battery_timin.rationale: sb_context depends on pitcher time-to-plate and per-play pop time whose public availability is unchecked; Savant exports can be inspected and the required data redefined with proxies.
hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_sb_battery_timin.catalog_action: Inspect Savant running-game/catcher exports for time-to-plate and per-play pop time; if absent, redefine sb_context with named proxies (season pop time, SB per opportunity, lead data).

hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_sb_green_light.rationale: Steal-attempt policy persistence within season is an unresolved specification of the team attempt-rate input, testable on public SB attempt data.
hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_sb_green_light.catalog_action: Research split-half persistence of team attempt-per-opportunity and manager-change effects, then author the green-light input with its shrinkage and update horizon.

offfield_markets#off_eoty_electorate.rationale: A stale gap left in offfield_markets after KXMLBEOTY moved; the electorate fact is a lookup and the record itself carries a misfiled gap, both closable by authoring.
offfield_markets#off_eoty_electorate.catalog_action: Remove off_eoty_electorate from offfield_markets and close it under lea_eoty_electorate by researching the executive award electorate and ballot.

offfield_markets#off_no_deadline.rationale: KXMLBFODTEAMS states no announcement deadline, so a labour-delayed schedule after close has no defined treatment; only Kalshi can clarify.

offfield_markets#off_reselection.rationale: The text does not cover replacement of an announced club, post-selection cancellation or relocation; resolvable only by Kalshi rules or settled examples.

offfield_markets#off_small_n.rationale: Staging/selection inputs are defined, but only two Field of Dreams games and under thirty special-event games exist, an inherent coverage limit of history.

offfield_markets#off_unstaged_inputs.rationale: Inputs for series that left offfield_markets remain defined there and will be attached at integration, so the archetype's input list is wrong.
offfield_markets#off_unstaged_inputs.catalog_action: Detach sale-stage hazard, manager award score, esports rating and manager candidate signal from offfield_markets and move them to the archetypes holding those series.

offfield_markets#off_venue_status.rationale: Venue readiness is a defined input known only from press reporting; a point-in-time history requires timestamped capture of league/site statements going forward.

pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks#erhw_hits.rationale: KXMLBHA says only 'hits allowed recorded' and is silent on error-to-hit scorer changes; Kalshi's settlement-timing policy must be published to resolve it.

pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks#erhw_join.rationale: The joint H/BB/ER dependence form (shared command latent vs batters-faced coupling) is undecided and a Gaussian copula may be wrong under truncated outings; an interaction the catalog has not specified.
pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks#erhw_join.catalog_action: Research candidate joint models on start-level public data and author the H/BB/ER dependence input with the chosen structure (latent factor or BF-coupled).

pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks#erhw_scor.rationale: Scorer-change behaviour is a defined concern; public feeds exist but changes are only observable by capturing box scores at game end and later, prospectively.

pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks#erhw_seri.rationale: Each ladder was sampled for one postseason start and one rung; other rungs, regular-season variants and postponement clauses are unseen in Kalshi text.

pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks#erhw_zero.rationale: ER/BB/H rules settle at fair price for non-starters but are silent on a starter leaving before facing a batter; sibling records' disagreement can only be settled by Kalshi text.

pitcher_outs#outs_cap_disclosure.rationale: Pitch-cap inputs are defined and disclosed in manager statements and beat reports; history requires prospective news-extraction capture since no structured feed exists.

pitcher_outs#outs_constants.rationale: Pitches per PA, cap range, out probability and the outs 19-20 claim are uncited author constants in the catalog, so the mechanism parameters may be wrong.
pitcher_outs#outs_constants.catalog_action: Replace the pitcher_outs constants with values and intervals researched from 2021-2025 start logs and PA events, citing the source for each.

pitcher_outs#outs_contract_scope.rationale: Only the 15+ KXMLBOUTS rung for one postseason start was sampled; other rungs and postponed/suspended/delayed-start settlement are not stated in Kalshi text.

pitcher_outs#outs_exit_lattice_stability.rationale: Whether manager exit lattices persist or are league convention is untested, which determines the manager shrinkage specification; settleable on public start logs.
pitcher_outs#outs_exit_lattice_stability.catalog_action: Research split-half cross-season persistence of manager exit lattices and author the shrinkage constant and league/manager split of the exit hazard input.

pitcher_outs#outs_hazard_naming.rationale: The starter exit hazard appears under three ids across sibling archetypes, a catalog definition defect that would yield separately fitted, drifting inputs.
pitcher_outs#outs_hazard_naming.catalog_action: Define one shared starter exit-hazard input id and remap sp_workload, sp_hook_hazard_curve and exit_boundary_mass in strikeouts, outs and earned-runs records.

pitcher_outs#outs_lineup_vintage.rationale: Lineup-dependent outs input is defined; card post times are not archived, so the pre-card mixture needs prospective capture of lineup posts.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_abs_challenge_data.rationale: abs_challenge_regime is defined, but no public export of 2026 challenge events is confirmed and only one partial season of the regime exists, a source and coverage limit.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_fair_price_definit.rationale: Rules settle scratches at 'the fair market price' without defining price or strike time; only Kalshi can define that settlement value.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_latent_state_size.rationale: The within-start 'stuff day' correlation is assumed positive with unknown size by arsenal; the dispersion input's form is unsettled but researchable on pitch-level data.
pitcher_strikeouts#ks_latent_state_size.catalog_action: Research the within-start latent correlation by arsenal type on held-out Statcast seasons and author the dispersion input with an evidenced magnitude or drop it.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_lineup_vintage.rationale: Lineup and umpire inputs are defined and published live, but appearance timestamps are not archived, requiring own snapshot capture for point-in-time backtests.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_postponement_rule.rationale: Sampled KXMLBKS rules say nothing about postponement, suspension, shortened games or long delays; only the full Kalshi rules or settled examples can resolve it.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_shape_constants.rationale: The step-shaped TTO penalty, 0.15-0.40 magnitudes and 1 mph threshold are uncited and may be the wrong functional form versus per-batter gradients.
pitcher_strikeouts#ks_shape_constants.catalog_action: Research per-batter-index K-rate and velocity-change effects from 2021-2025 play-by-play and rewrite the TTO input's shape and constants with citations.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_source_of_truth.rationale: No data source is named in KXMLBKS rules and whether Kalshi re-reads after scorer changes is unknown; only a Kalshi clarification resolves it.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_talent_prior_gap.rationale: Pitcher talent has no stuff-model or projection K% prior for arsenal changes, injury returns or rookies, a missing input exactly where whiff samples are thin.
pitcher_strikeouts#ks_talent_prior_gap.catalog_action: Define a pitcher K% prior input (pitch-model stuff grade or ZiPS/Steamer projection) with its source and blending rule versus k_rates and pitch_type_whiff.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_zero_batter_starte.rationale: KXMLBKS is silent on a starter who leaves before facing a batter (injury, ejection, rain); only Kalshi rules or a settled example can say fair price or zero.

player_participation#pp_cba_lockout.rationale: 2027 participation windows depend on mlb.labor_stoppage_regime, defined in transactions but not staged in player_participation, a missing input attachment.
player_participation#pp_cba_lockout.catalog_action: Stage mlb.labor_stoppage_regime in player_participation for 2027 KXMLBSTART/STARTER/PITCH windows and note cancelled-game treatment as a contract dependency.

player_participation#pp_mixed_family.rationale: KXMLBSTARTER and KXMLBSTARTINGLINEUP are title-only in the sample, so probable-vs-actual and their difference from KXMLBSTART are undefined until Kalshi publishes rules.

player_participation#pp_opp_starter_vint.rationale: Platoon start decisions depend on the opposing probable starter's identity, hand and announcement time, but no input carries them; platoon is only a stand-in.
player_participation#pp_opp_starter_vint.catalog_action: Define an opposing-probable-starter input (identity, hand, announcement timestamp) and attach it to the player_participation manager-decision stage.

player_participation#pp_posting_vintage.rationale: Late-scratch probability is defined; free feeds do not archive lineup posting and scratch times, so calibration needs prospective capture.

player_participation#pp_postseason_regim.rationale: Sampled start markets are October games while the rest-day constructs are regular-season ones; a postseason/round input is missing from the manager-decision stage.
player_participation#pp_postseason_regim.catalog_action: Author a postseason round and roster-eligibility input for player_participation and specify separate postseason start-probability treatment.

player_participation#pp_rehab_data.rationale: Rehab-stage input is defined but its source is unstructured beat reporting with small per-injury samples; no structured public rehab-stage feed exists.

player_participation#pp_return_scope.rationale: KXMLBRETURN does not say whether postseason games count, how a trade settles or whether a resumed suspended game counts; only Kalshi rules or examples resolve it.

player_participation#pp_start_rules_trun.rationale: The sampled KXMLBSTART rules_secondary is cut off mid-clause, hiding plate-appearance and postponement terms; the full Kalshi text is required.

player_participation#pp_twoway_plan.rationale: Two-way pitching plans are rarely disclosed and only a handful of two-way players exist, so the plan-change rate input is limited by unavailable and sparse source data.

season_futures#sf_2027_cancellation.rationale: KXMLB 2027 text does not say how a shortened or cancelled season/postseason settles; only Kalshi wording resolves it.

season_futures#sf_extremes_short_season.rationale: 100-loss and streak texts are silent on shortened seasons and suspended games within streaks; Kalshi must clarify.

season_futures#sf_injury_hazard.rationale: ROS-WAR-at-risk input is defined; injury return timelines are not published in structured form and disclosure varies by team, a source limitation.

season_futures#sf_mixed_families.rationale: KXMLBWS lacks rules in the sample and no sampled text covers cancelled seasons or postponed games inside streaks; requires Kalshi rule text.

season_futures#sf_playoff_adjustment.rationale: Playoff rating weights are defined but weakly identified from few postseason series per year, an inherent coverage limit of available history.

season_futures#sf_projection_vintage.rationale: Projection prior is defined and ZiPS/Steamer/PECOTA publish each preseason, but vintages are not archived free, so own capture going forward (or paid archives) is needed.

season_futures#sf_tiebreaker_source.rationale: Seed tiebreaker order is an uncited author paraphrase and bracket reseeding is unstated; both are MLB rule facts the author can look up.
season_futures#sf_tiebreaker_source.catalog_action: Research MLB's official tiebreaker procedure and 12-team postseason bracket rules and record them with citations for seed, qualifier and KXMLBMATCHUP markets.

season_futures#sf_wbc_rules.rationale: WBC pitch limits and tiebreakers are stated from memory, a researchable rule fact; the contract silence on cancellation is secondary.
season_futures#sf_wbc_rules.catalog_action: Research the official 2026 World Baseball Classic tournament regulations (pitch limits, tiebreakers, mercy rule) and correct the KXMLBWORLD inputs with citations.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_cowinner_p.rationale: Only Comeback Player lists a Tie/Co-Winners outcome; co-winner payout for other awards is unstated and only Kalshi can define it.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_electorate.rationale: Award electorates (Reliever, Hank Aaron, Comeback, Executive) are stated from memory, undermining the shared Plackett-Luce claim; these are lookups.
season_leaders_and_awards#lea_electorate.catalog_action: Research each award's published voting body and procedure and record electorates with citations, splitting award models where electorates differ.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_eoty_elect.rationale: Which executive award KXMLBEOTY settles on and its electorate is unverified, so the applicable rank model is unknown; researchable from award documentation.
season_leaders_and_awards#lea_eoty_elect.catalog_action: Identify the Executive of the Year award matching KXMLBEOTY's 'Governing League' and research its electorate and ballot format, then fix the model inputs.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_narrative_.rationale: Narrative has no quantitative definition in the catalog, so the input is undefined rather than merely unmeasured.
season_leaders_and_awards#lea_narrative_.catalog_action: Define narrative flags (milestone, comeback, first-year, position) with tagging rules and sources as a concrete input for award vote-share models.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_qualificat.rationale: Triple Crown text says only 'leads their league' without qualification standard or tie treatment; the contract reading needs Kalshi rule text.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_roy_rule.rationale: Rookie-eligibility thresholds for 2026 are unverified from an official source, a rule fact the author can look up.
season_leaders_and_awards#lea_roy_rule.catalog_action: Research the official MLB/BBWAA rookie eligibility thresholds (130 AB / 50 IP / 45 days) for 2026 and cite them in the ROY inputs.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_silent_cla.rationale: Most award texts lack co-winner/tie clauses, Source Agencies are unnamed and TEAMSTAT variants are unseen; only Kalshi rules resolve these.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_voter_data.rationale: Voter model inputs are defined; individual ballots are public only post-announcement and Gold Glove/Silver Slugger ballot details are limited, a source limitation.

transactions#tr_filing.rationale: KXMLBCOACH is title-only and NEXTTEAM text is truncated, so interim-manager counting and resolution date are unknown until Kalshi publishes rules.

transactions#tr_lockout_forecast.rationale: labour_stoppage_regime is defined, but no public series codes negotiation state; a coded negotiation timeline must be captured prospectively.

transactions#tr_report_data.rationale: Transaction-report input is defined; whether MLB Trade Rumors/beat archives give complete timestamped history is unverified, a source-access limitation.

transactions#tr_settlement_assumed.rationale: NEXTTEAM, DEBUT and COACH texts omit official-announcement, physical and voiding terms (COACH is title-only); requires Kalshi rule text.

transactions#tr_small_n.rationale: Manager changes and specific transaction types are rare, so hazard estimates are coverage-limited by the small history regardless of definition.

transactions#tr_trade_processing_time.rationale: KXMLBTRADE does not name the processing timestamp source or overnight-processing treatment; only Kalshi clarification resolves borderline deadline deals.

unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_derby_ext.rationale: Derby total/500ft/longest/EV texts are silent on swing-off and extension homers; only Kalshi clarification or settlement values resolve it.

unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_derby_rul.rationale: The 2026 Derby format comes from press reports and official rules (takes, pairing, pitch limits) were not read; a rule fact researchable via other accessible sources.
unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_derby_rul.catalog_action: Research the official 2026 Home Run Derby rules via accessible mirrors (MLB press release copies, wire reports) and confirm against 2026 round results.

unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_futures_t.rationale: Futures Game level translation factors are placeholders in the catalog, i.e. an undefined input parameter set.
unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_futures_t.catalog_action: Research minor-to-major level translation factors from public MiLB-MLB transition data and replace the Futures Game placeholders with cited values.

unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_mvp_vote_.rationale: ASG MVP panel composition and fan-vote weight for 2026 were not checked; a documented procedure fact the author can look up.
unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_mvp_vote_.catalog_action: Research MLB's 2026 All-Star MVP voting procedure (panel composition, fan-vote weight) and record it in the MVP input definition.

unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_small_sam.rationale: Participation and PA models are defined, but only about a dozen All-Star Games exist under the current regime, an inherent coverage limit.

unreg:all_star_week_events#asw_total_hr_.rationale: KXMLBALLSTARHR, unlike ASGHIT/ASGHR, does not exclude swing-off stats; whether swing-off homers count is a Kalshi clarification.

unreg:amateur_draft_selection#draft_club.rationale: Club boards and pre-draft deals are private; public mocks are a noisy proxy, so the raw source is fundamentally inaccessible.

unreg:amateur_draft_selection#draft_comp.rationale: Rules do not say whether compensation picks count toward 'overall pick' or whether top 10 includes 10th; a contract convention only Kalshi can confirm.

unreg:amateur_draft_selection#draft_lott.rationale: Lottery odds by rank, repeat-winner restrictions and the no-higher-than-10th rule are unverified CBA facts that change who holds settling slots.
unreg:amateur_draft_selection#draft_lott.catalog_action: Research the CBA draft lottery article or MLB's official odds release and author exact odds and eligibility rules into the draft inputs.

unreg:amateur_draft_selection#draft_no_s.rationale: rules_secondary is empty: no source of truth and no postponement/withdrawal clause; requires Kalshi to publish rules for current markets.

unreg:labour_stoppage_and_season_schedul.rationale: The Dec 1 2026 CBA expiry date was not verified against the CBA text, a simple lookup the author can do.
unreg:labour_stoppage_and_season_schedul.catalog_action: Verify the CBA expiry date from the CBA text or official MLB/MLBPA announcements and cite it in the labour inputs.

unreg:labour_stoppage_and_season_schedul.rationale: KXMLBSEASONGAMES 'games played above 600' does not exclude a team-game reading; only Kalshi can state the counting unit.
Rules do not say whether suspended/shortened contests count or which source counts games; requires Kalshi rules or clarification.
The leverage ratio is defined; owner cost inputs rest on third-party Forbes/Sportico estimates because audited revenue is undisclosed.
Hazard shape is defined, but only a handful of comparable stoppages exist, so validation is limited by the history available.
Bargaining proposals and sessions are private; only leaks are visible, so the gap index source is inaccessible.
Neither rules text says whether replacement-player games count as MLB regular season or first game; an operator clarification is required.
Opening Day text gives no time zone for a game near midnight on the deadline; only Kalshi can state the convention.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_first.rationale: Rules do not say whether a live or broadcast 107+ reading counts if later corrected; source and correction policy need Kalshi wording.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_kxmlb.rationale: KXMLBSTAT is generic and only one velocity market was sampled; non-velocity KXMLBSTAT markets would have no archetype, a catalog routing gap.
unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_kxmlb.catalog_action: List all KXMLBSTAT tickers from the series ledger and route non-velocity markets to an archetype with their own inputs.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_park_.rationale: Park speed-offset and revision-frequency inputs are defined; measuring post-game release_speed revisions requires repeated prospective pulls of Statcast.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_sourc.rationale: Rules name no tracking source or rounding; 107.0+ vs 107+ and radar conflicts need Kalshi clarification.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_tail_.rationale: 107 mph lies beyond every tracked pitch, so the tail endpoint cannot be estimated from any data; the limitation is the absence of observations.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_tempe.rationale: The cold-air velocity penalty driving the tail lift is unverified against literature or Statcast fits; a researchable coefficient of a stated mechanism.
unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_tempe.catalog_action: Research published temperature-velocity estimates and fit the coefficient on 2021-2025 Statcast fastballs with pitcher effects, citing the result in the input.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_windo.rationale: 'Any game during the season' does not specify spring, ASG, suspended completions or WBC games; requires Kalshi rule text.

unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials#.rationale: Only one rung/player per remaining family (SISTREAK, NEXTHR, PLAYOFFHRS) was sampled; other variants' wording is unseen in Kalshi text.
Five series with three mechanisms share one input list that serves none fully; the catalog lacks proper archetype entries for them.
unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials#.catalog_action: Split player_and_team_counting_specials into postseason-count, player-exposure and streak archetypes with their own mechanisms and input lists.

unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials#.rationale: SERIESHR and NEXTHR texts do not cover injured or benched players or postseason inclusion; only Kalshi rules or examples resolve settlement.
KXMLBSISTREAK does not say whether unearned or inherited-runner runs break the streak; a contract reading only Kalshi can settle.
The streak survival input may overstate persistence because as-of rates are not regressed for selection on luck; the input definition needs revision.
unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials#.catalog_action: Research continuation of all 30+ inning scoreless streaks since 1990 and redefine the streak survival input with explicit selection-corrected regression.

unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials#.rationale: KXMLBWALKOFFS title says home runs while its rule counts any walk-off; which event counts per strike requires Kalshi rule text.

unreg:playoff_series_markets#ply_game_de.rationale: Within-series dependence is defined as a test, but the postseason history is a few dozen series a year, limiting identification by coverage.

unreg:playoff_series_markets#ply_host_de.rationale: KXMLBPLAYOFFHOST does not define whether borrowed/temporary/neutral-site home games count; requires Kalshi clarification.

unreg:playoff_series_markets#ply_hosting.rationale: Home patterns per round and wild-card format were written from memory; MLB's official postseason format is a lookup.
unreg:playoff_series_markets#ply_hosting.catalog_action: Research MLB's official postseason format (round lengths, 2-3-2/2-2-1 patterns, wild-card hosting) and correct the hosting-pattern input with citations.

unreg:playoff_series_markets#ply_team_la.rationale: All sampled series markets are World Series; whether earlier rounds are listed with format-specific strikes depends on Kalshi listings not in the sample.

unreg:playoff_series_markets#ply_unfinis.rationale: No sampled KXMLBSERIES* rules address suspended or unfinished series; full Kalshi rules and settlement notes are required.
